document.about: Sherwin-Williams Emerald interior paint product data sheet (2 pages). Its title, `Emerald® Symmetry™` over `Interior Acrylic Matte`, is set at 17pt on page 1 and restated at the head of page 2.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#176): a raised sign in a display title broke the title's line at the sign: the `®` 19pt up on 32pt type, or a `™` whose following space was set at the title's size.
2026-11-24: rewritten for page 2's restated title read as running text (#170). Page 1's title, its sign and the line under it, is the one SectionTitle that names the product.
2026-11-26: the document's title is a `doco:Title`, the document's header, apart from its sections, as a Word document's and a deck's are. The title's checks look for it there.

checks.issue: The `™` after `Symmetry` was a paragraph of its own.
The title heads no section of its own as well: once, as the document's title.
